contributions.content: Strong AI-driven demand and CPO commercialization support the growth thesis, but inventory growth of 178.7% versus revenue growth of 31.5% creates a material execution and capital-efficiency concern. A roughly 52x TTM P/E also leaves limited valuation protection if anticipated growth disappoints.

contributions.content: Strategic inventory build (+178.7% YTD to RMB 1.274B) and improved core-material availability drove Q3 sequential revenue +28.4%, aligning with hyperscaler 800G/1.6T and early CPO volume needs.
evidence: Inventory RMB 1.274B, described as CPO/NPO prebuild

contributions.content: The 52x TTM valuation leaves little room and the 35x de-rating math checks out at about -33%, but the strategic inventory view is not yet backed by cash: Q3 operating cash flow covered only 0.52x net profit while inventory rose 178.7% YTD.
evidence: Q3 OCF about RMB 0.46bn, 0.52x net profit

conclusion_text: All three agents accept the growth thesis and the valuation risk; they disagree on whether the inventory build is strategic preparation or a cash-conversion warning, and all condition approval on FY26 cash flow recovery and measurable CPO revenue.

Whether operating cash flow recovers toward 0.9x net profit.
Customer concentration and top-five share are undisclosed.
